verdict: Organic is holding, but paid activity is paused pending contract resolution.
narrative: No paid ads ran in the last 28 days — zero spend, zero paid leads — because the contract extension is still being finalized, which is the direct blocker on all paid channels. Your organic presence is carrying the load: Search Console recorded 534 clicks and 40,404 impressions this period, with clicks up 30% compared to the prior week. Google Business Profile showed 142 actions over the 28-day window (48 calls, 94 web clicks), though activity appears to have dropped off in the most recent 7 days, which is being investigated as a listing or tracking issue. Once the contract is signed, paid campaigns are ready to launch and the pipeline will have the top-of-funnel input it needs to move.
